Package frc.robot.subsystems.elevator

Class AbstractElevatorSubsystem

java.lang.Object
edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.SubsystemBase
frc.robot.subsystems.elevator.AbstractElevatorSubsystem
All Implemented Interfaces:
edu.wpi.first.util.sendable.Sendable, edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.Subsystem, AutoCloseable
Direct Known Subclasses:
ElevatorSubsystem, SimElevatorSubsystem
public abstract class AbstractElevatorSubsystem extends edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.SubsystemBase implements AutoCloseable
Shared position-control implementation for real and simulated elevators.

Sensor values, limit switches, and zeroing are supplied as callbacks so this class does not depend on a particular encoder or simulation implementation. PID and feedforward controllers are injected by the caller.

    • AbstractElevatorSubsystem

      Parameters:
      pid - position controller
      feedforward - elevator feedforward controller
      motor - motor controller receiving the computed voltage
      lowerLimit - lower travel limit in meters
      upperLimit - upper travel limit in meters
      startingHeight - initial target height in meters

      velocityMetersPerSecond - current-velocity supplier
      atLowerLimit - lower-limit supplier
      atUpperLimit - upper-limit supplier
      zeroEncoder - action that resets the mechanism position
